    def __init__(self):
        self.cap = 200           # allocation size

    def base(self):           # returned pszLine pointer

        if self.size_word - 1 < required:
            nNewSize = required + 4 + 500
            self.cap = nNewSize
            self.size_word = nNewSize - 4
